test.create_query: CREATE TABLE text_index_lazy_wide ( id UInt64, s String, INDEX idx s TYPE text(tokenizer = splitByNonAlpha, posting_list_codec = 'bitpacking') GRANULARITY 100000000 ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
test.query: SELECT count() FROM text_index_lazy_wide WHERE hasToken(s, 'dense')
SELECT count() FROM text_index_lazy_wide WHERE hasToken(s, 'half')
SELECT count() FROM text_index_lazy_wide WHERE hasAnyTokens(s, ['dense', 'medium', 'sparse'])
SELECT count() FROM text_index_lazy_wide WHERE hasAnyTokens(s, ['half', 'third', 'quarter', 'fifth'])
SELECT count() FROM text_index_lazy_wide WHERE hasAllTokens(s, ['dense', 'medium']) SETTINGS text_index_lazy_intersection_density_threshold = 0
SELECT count() FROM text_index_lazy_wide WHERE hasAllTokens(s, ['half', 'third', 'quarter'])
SELECT count() FROM text_index_lazy_wide WHERE hasAllTokens(s, ['dense', 'medium'])
SELECT count() FROM text_index_lazy_wide WHERE hasAllTokens(s, ['half', 'third']) SETTINGS text_index_lazy_intersection_density_threshold = 1
SELECT count() FROM text_index_lazy_wide WHERE hasAllTokens(s, ['half', 'third', 'quarter', 'fifth']) SETTINGS text_index_lazy_intersection_density_threshold = 1
SELECT count() FROM text_index_lazy_wide WHERE hasAllTokens(s, ['third', 'sparse'])
SELECT count() FROM text_index_lazy_wide WHERE hasAllTokens(s, ['half', 'third']) SETTINGS text_index_lazy_intersection_density_threshold = 1, max_threads = 4
SELECT count() FROM text_index_lazy_wide WHERE hasAllTokens(s, ['half', 'third', 'quarter', 'fifth']) SETTINGS text_index_lazy_intersection_density_threshold = 1, max_threads = 4
